title: Claude Feature 07: Usage limit kaise chalti hai, kaise bachayein #shorts
description:
Claude Feature 07 (Claude for Everyone): usage limits. Paid plans me ek session limit hoti hai jo har paanch ghante me reset hoti hai, aur period pehla message bhejte hi shuru hota hai. Iske upar weekly limits bhi hoti hain. claude.ai, Claude Code aur Claude Desktop ka usage ek hi limit me ginta hai. Usage bachane ke tareeke: thinking ya effort kam rakho, jo apps aur web search na chahiye unhe band rakho, aur lambi chat ki jagah nayi chat kholo. Apna usage Settings, phir Usage me dekho: bacha hua time aur agla weekly reset wahin dikhta hai. Limits badal sakti hain, isliye official page dekhte raho.

Source (official):
https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11647753-how-do-usage-and-length-limits-work

Unofficial channel, not affiliated with Anthropic.

Note: the docs crops are our own capture of the official help page (key line highlighted). The clock, calendar and settings screens are illustrations. Synthetic voice.

Music: "Funkorama" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
